input: Open a joint bank account with my spouse

gold.taskTitle: Open a Joint Bank Account With Spouse
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to open a joint bank account together with their spouse.

questions.title: Do you already have a bank in mind?
questions.description: Identify whether the user has a preferred bank or is still deciding.

questions.title: Is this account for daily spending or specific savings?
questions.description: Understand the primary purpose of the joint account.

questions.title: Do you both currently bank at the same institution?
questions.description: Determine if consolidating existing accounts is a factor.

questions.title: What is your timeline for getting this done?
questions.description: Establish urgency and any deadlines the user has in mind.

questions.title: Will you apply online or visit a branch in person?
questions.description: Clarify the preferred method of opening the account.

questions.title: Are there minimum balance or fee requirements you want to avoid?
questions.description: Identify financial constraints that will affect bank or account type selection.

questions.title: Do you both have government-issued ID and documents ready?
questions.description: Check whether required identification and paperwork are already on hand.
